Name: Mary of Bethany
Summary: Mary of Bethany was Martha and Lazarus's sister, known for sitting at Jesus' feet to listen and for anointing Him with costly perfume. Jesus defended her devotion and said her act would be told wherever the gospel is preached.
KeyStory: Mary poured a pound of pure nard on Jesus' feet and wiped them with her hair, and the house was filled with the fragrance.
LifeLesson: What others called waste, Jesus called beautiful. Pour out your love on Jesus without calculating — devotion to Him is never wasted.
